seo.title: About us
seo.description: Meet Hammer Construction Scotland, a local building team based in Shortlees, Kilmarnock.

hero.title: Your local building team
hero.text: Hammer Construction Scotland is a hands-on building company based in Shortlees, serving homeowners right across East Ayrshire.

story.title: Craftsmanship you can rely on
story.body:
Hammer Construction Scotland, based in the heart of Shortlees, is your go-to solution for construction across East Ayrshire. As driveway contractors, builders and specialists in extensions, loft conversions and renovations, we pride ourselves on turning your plans into reality.

Every project is different, so we tailor our work to your needs, your home and your budget. We use high-quality materials and proven techniques so the result looks great and lasts.

From the first visit to the final clean-up, you deal with the same team. We keep you updated, we turn up when we say we will, and we leave your home tidy.

items.title: Honest pricing
items.text: Clear, written quotes with no hidden extras. You know the cost before we start.

items.title: Quality first
items.text: Proper foundations, good materials and careful finishing on every job.

items.title: Clear communication
items.text: One point of contact who keeps you updated at every stage.

items.title: Respect for your home
items.text: Tidy sites, protected floors and a full clean-up when we finish.
